name: Sit-Down Breakfast Power Buckwheat Crepe (Egg Whites, Silky Tofu & Spinach)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Dairy-free buckwheat crepe with egg whites and silky tofu is high-protein, though broccoli florets, mushrooms, and pico de gallo add roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the kitchen to fill your buckwheat crepe with scrambled egg whites and tofu only—holding the broccoli, mushrooms, scallions, and tomato relish.
